transcript: If I just had a laptop and a Wi-Fi connection, the first thing I would do would be I would search for some local businesses in my area using Google, and then I would go to the contact us page on those websites, and I would also get their phone number, and I would reach out to them via phone and via cold call and ask them if they have any old leads that they've given up on that we can turn into sales on a performance basis using AI. Okay, that's an offer that they just don't say no to.
